I highly recommend this grill if you are in the market!

Results.ReviewText: I had previously owned a copper Genesis, for approximately six years... Great grill, but the hood disintegrated over time and pieces of metal were falling into our food on the grill - so time for a new one... the Genesis was bigger than we really needed, so I decided to go with the Spirit E-310. Bought it assembled from HD. Couldn't justify spending $800 again for Genesis - but maybe I should have... the Spirit is much lighter and clearly more cheaply made.... the stainless (if they are stainless) side tables scratch very easily already. There's no enclosed cabinet, and I wanted the GS ignition, but you couldn't get that with the enclosed cabinet Spirit, and couldn't justify the additional price. Lights easily every time.... glad to have the 10 year warranty now, but we'll see what it really covers in time. Have tried other non-Weber grills in the past, and they are just not worth it - despite the cheaper cost... only time will tell with this one... sorry that they seemed to stop making them in different colors...definitely seems like Weber tried to shave as much money as they could from materials to build this one... oh well..
Results.Title: Probable good buy, but....
